raw_text: Major PDF offensive in Sagaing Region near India border. Multiple SAC bases overrun between Tamu and Kalay. Junta responding with air strikes. Thousands of displaced civilians heading towards Manipur. Indian security forces on high alert at Moreh border gate. Reports of weapons movement across border area.
